title: Loi du 2 décembre 2024 relative à la publication, par certaines sociétés et groupes, d'informations en matière de durabilité et à l'assurance de l'information en matière de durabilité et portant dispositions diverses
citation: Loi du 2 décembre 2024 (Numac 2024011683), Moniteur belge 20 décembre 2024, p. 136124; transposes Directive (EU) 2022/2464
evidence: Header of the Justel page (fr) fetched 2026-11-02: "Publication: 20 décembre 2024 ... Numéro: 2024011683 ... Entrée en vigueur : 30 décembre 2024". Art. 2: "La présente loi transpose la directive (UE) 2022/2464 du Parlement européen et du Conseil du 14 décembre 2022".
notes: Stored 2026-11-02: adopted text as published in the Moniteur belge of 2024-12-20 (fr, nl), and the three Justel versions, each in fr and nl: 2024-12-30 (archive 001), 2025-12-23 (archive 002, after the amending law of 12 December 2025, art. 116 stop-the-clock) and 2026-07-31 (current, after the law of 15 July 2026, art. 116). German: Justel lists no official translation; it lists the unofficial German coordination (Inoffizielle Koordinierung, numac 2026002484, Moniteur belge 2026-04-15) which states it reflects the act as amended by the law of 12 December 2025, so it is stored as a translation dated 2025-12-23. No government English translation: looked for on the Justel language bar (nl, fr, de only) and in the Moniteur belge page of the act (nl, fr, de only), 2026-11-02. The act amends the Code des sociétés et des associations (be-csa-art-3-6-3-32), the law of 20 September 1948 and others; only the CSA articles are in scope.

title: Code des sociétés et des associations, Art. 3:6 and 3:32 with the sustainability reporting sections 3:6/1 to 3:6/9 and 3:32/1 to 3:32/6 (rapport de gestion, déclaration non financière)
citation: Loi du 23 mars 2019 introduisant le Code des sociétés et des associations (Numac 2019A40586), Moniteur belge 4 avril 2019, Art. 3:6 § 4 and 3:32 § 2; sections 3:6/1 ff. inserted by the law of 2 December 2024
evidence: Header of the Justel page (fr) fetched 2026-11-02: "23 MARS 2019. - Code des sociétés et des associations ... Publication: 4 avril 2019 ... Entrée en vigueur : 1 mai 2019 1 janvier 2020 ... 25 versions archivées".
notes: Record text is the Justel title line plus Art. 3:6 to the line before Art. 3:7 and Art. 3:32 to the line before Art. 3:33 (the article, its sub-articles /1 and following, and their footnotes). Justel offers 26 versions (25 archives and the current text); the cut text changed in 4, stored in fr and nl: 2019-05-01 (archive 001, the Code as it entered into force), 2020-05-06 (archive 002), 2024-12-30 (archive 024, first text with the sustainability sections, same date as the law of 2 December 2024) and 2026-09-01 (current text, delayed entry into force of an amendment published 2026-04-02). Version dates come from the header of the preceding archive (see SOURCES.md ## Belgium) and can be off for retroactive or staggered amendments; the fetched_url names the exact archive. The Code as published in the Moniteur belge is not stored. German: Justel lists German coordinations of Book 3 as separate entries (numac 2020021215 and others, unofficial, not fetched). No government English translation: looked for on the Justel language bar (nl, fr, de only) and in the Moniteur belge page of the act (nl, fr, de only), 2026-11-02.

title: Décret du 10 novembre 2004 instaurant un système d'échange de quotas d'émission de gaz à effet de serre, créant un Fonds wallon Kyoto et relatif aux mécanismes de flexibilité du Protocole de Kyoto
citation: Décret de la Région wallonne du 10 novembre 2004 (Numac 2004203609), Moniteur belge 2 décembre 2004, p. 80700
evidence: Header of the Justel page (fr) fetched 2026-11-02: "10 NOVEMBRE 2004. - Décret instaurant un système d'échange de quotas d'émission de gaz à effet de serre ... Publication: 2 décembre 2004 ... Entrée en vigueur : 2 décembre 2004 ... 11 versions archivées 78 arrêtés d'exécution".
notes: ETS is a regional competence; no federal ETS act was found on Justel (the federal level has the aviation cooperation agreement of 2 September 2013 and its assent acts, not stored). Stored 2026-11-02: adopted French text (Moniteur belge 2004-12-02) and 11 French Justel versions (2006-07-22 to 2025-05-02); the Dutch text, which the Justel title calls "(VERTALING)", is stored as 11 translation records of the same dates. Archive 001 (valid 2004-12-02 to 2006-07-22) holds only the modified articles and is not stored; the adopted text covers that period. Dates follow the preceding archive's header (earliest "En vigueur jusqu'au" on or after the amending decree's publication), so retroactive parts of later amendments are not separate versions. The Moniteur's Dutch text of 2004-12-02 is not stored separately. The 78 implementing orders are not in scope. Amended by be-wallonia-ets2-decree-2025. No government English translation: looked for on the Justel language bar (nl, fr, de only) and in the Moniteur belge page of the act (nl, fr, de only), 2026-11-02.
